title: Recipe 08: Multi-page task continuity
summary: A full document navigation replaces the page. The pending task resumes on the detail document and returns to the list when done.
summaryZh: 整页导航替换 document。待完成任务在详情文档恢复，完成后返回列表。

files.label: main.ts
files.roleZh: 连续性与运行时初始化

files.label: README.md
files.roleZh: 本地运行与完整任务提示

guide.title: Resume on a new document, not in a hidden iframe
guide.titleZh: 在新的 document 恢复，而不是藏在 iframe 里
intro: Opening a customer changes the URL and reloads the application. No client route keeps the old DOM alive.
The continuity checkpoint is bounded; the detail page declares its own note field and save action.
introZh: 打开客户会改变 URL 并重新加载应用，没有客户端路由让旧 DOM 存活。
连续性检查点有明确边界；详情页重新声明自己的备注字段与保存动作。

steps.title: Name the continuity scope
steps.body: The runtime uses a stable key, automatic resume, and return-on-done.
steps.bodyZh: 运行时使用稳定 key、自动恢复与完成后返回。

steps.title: Navigate as a person does
steps.body: The record link performs a normal full navigation.
steps.bodyZh: 记录链接执行普通整页导航。

steps.title: Finish on the second page
steps.body: The detail document declares the save tool and verifies the saved note.
steps.bodyZh: 详情文档声明保存工具，并验证备注已保存。

guide.note: Ask: “Open Globex, set the note to Dinner on Friday, and save it.” The assistant should end on the detail document, save once, and return to the list.
guide.noteZh: 输入：“打开 Globex，把备注写成周五约吃饭，然后保存。”助手应在详情文档保存一次并返回列表。
